reviewSamples.text: The whole team is straightforward, honest, and the pricing is the fairest you will find in the area. I’ve gone to a few other places locally but every one of them has been crazy expensive or unwilling to work with my vehicle (2013 Ford C-Max Energi). Orlando Hybrid Auto Repair has consistently gone above and beyond for me.
